'''Clue scroll (elite)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite]] [[Treasure Trails]].

You can use this clue step to obtain some of the combat achievements for the [[Shellbane gryphon]], even while not on a slayer task. However, the gryphon will also not drop anything if the clue is not your inventory when it dies.
